tools.name: search_jobs
tools.description: Search live veterinary job listings on VetJobs.au, Australia's dedicated veterinary job board: veterinarian, veterinary nurse, locum, practice manager, reception and animal care roles posted by clinics, hospitals and practices across Australia (plus some New Zealand roles), with no recruiter middlem

tools.name: get_job
tools.description: Fetch a single live listing by its numeric id, in the same shape search_jobs returns, including embedded schema.org JobPosting structured data. Returns an error if the listing is unknown, unpublished or expired — treat that as 'no longer available' rather than retrying.

tools.name: list_categories
tools.description: The board's vocabulary and volume: every occupation category with its live count, the states that currently have listings, the total active count and the first-party vs imported split. Call this first to learn valid filter values and how much inventory exists before searching.

tools.name: recent_changes
tools.description: Incremental sync: every listing created or updated since the given ISO 8601 timestamp, newest first. Poll this instead of re-fetching the whole board — combine with the returned ids to keep a local copy current. Expired listings are never returned.
